name: genbioca-compliance-platform
description: Repository-level orchestration for the active frontend and backend applications

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend & wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.guard: npm run guard:router --prefix frontend && npm run guard:boundaries --prefix frontend && npm run guard:routes --prefix frontend && npm run guard:production-api --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:static: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run guard
